verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an implementation criterion requiring a smaller, thinner whisk compatible with fine matcha powder and the selected 4.5-quart bowl.
The client selects the referenced matcha-whisk profile as the physical whisk-head design for fine-powder mixing.
The client materially reopens the whisk-head material and profile choice by asking whether stainless steel or a milk-frother-style head would perform better than resin.
The client unambiguously accepts the immediately preceding stainless-steel whisk proposal, changing the selected physical whisk design and material without leaving stale conflicting attributes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The whisk works for me. For the motors, I propose setting the maximum speed at 2600—what do you think?

missing_event_candidates.decision_note: After accepting the stainless-steel whisk proposal, the client resolves the material and design ambiguity and returns the Requirement to active status.
